mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.round_id, t.task_status, t.lottery_seed, t.lottery_courses, t.total_count, t.processed_count, t.admitted_count, t.rejected_count, t.error_msg, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, r.round_name as round_name from tpm_lottery_task t left join tpm_selection_round r on t.round_id = r.round_id
mapper.select: where t.round_id = #{roundId} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.task_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert:
insert into tpm_lottery_task
round_id, task_status, lottery_seed, lottery_courses, total_count, processed_count, admitted_count, rejected_count, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag,
#{roundId}, #{taskStatus}, #{lotterySeed}, #{lotteryCourses}, #{totalCount}, #{processedCount}, #{admittedCount}, #{rejectedCount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, '0',
mapper.update: update tpm_lottery_task set task_status = '1', start_time = #{startTime}, update_time = #{startTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and task_status = '0' and del_flag = '0'

update tpm_lottery_task set processed_count = #{processedCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, admitted_count = #{admittedCount}, rejected_count = #{rejectedCount}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'

update tpm_lottery_task set task_status = '2', lottery_seed = #{lotterySeed}, lottery_courses = #{lotteryCourses}, total_count = #{totalCount}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, admitted_count = #{admittedCount}, rejected_count = #{rejectedCount}, error_msg = null, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and task_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
update tpm_lottery_task set task_status = '3', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{endTime} where task_id = #{taskId} and task_status in ('0','1') and del_flag = '0'
update tpm_lottery_task set del_flag = '2' where task_id = #{taskId}
